reports.name: Fee Note Aging Report
reports.description: Outstanding fee notes grouped by age bucket.

reports.name: Matter Profitability Report
reports.description: Revenue vs. cost per matter for a date range.

reports.name: Timesheet Report
reports.description: Time entries grouped by member, matter, or date for a given period.

reports.name: Trust Receipts & Payments
reports.description: Chronological journal of all trust receipts and payments for a date range.

reports.name: Trust Creditors List (Rule 54.15)
reports.description: Every person and non-client creditor for whom trust money is held, as at a date — the locked monthly list where one exists.

reports.name: Trust Position as at a Date
reports.description: The cashbook against every trust creditor as at any date, per account and firm-wide, with the integrity flags.

reports.name: Client Ledger Statement
reports.description: Per-client transaction history with running balance.

reports.name: Trust Reconciliation
reports.description: Bank, cashbook and trust creditors compared at the reconciliation's period end, with the stored creditor breakdown.

reports.name: Investment Register
reports.description: Every trust investment on the books: account, basis, principal, balance and interest — gross, the Fund's 5% and net.

reports.name: Interest and Charges Schedule (Rule 54.28)
reports.description: Rule 54.28: interest earned and charges levied per trust account and month, the Fund ledger brought forward and carried forward; memo figures shown separately.

reports.name: Unidentified Deposits Age Analysis
reports.description: Unidentified deposits open as at a date by age band, and those allocated or paid to the Fund in the twelve months to it.

reports.name: Section 35 Data Pack
reports.description: Composite report combining all trust sub-reports for Section 35 compliance.
